proposal.reason: Primary change is symmetric-memory collective batching: scheduler/kernel argument layout, per-work slicing, block-offset semantics, LL eligibility for grouped works, and symmetric kernel selection/CTA sizing are all substantive symmetric behavior changes. Enqueue also needs review because launch-time argument ABI handling, plan fields, and pooled-argument ownership/cleanup paths were changed in shared kernel-launch/reclaim/group cleanup flows. Dispatch needs review because dispatch-strategy caching/indexing moved from algorithm ID to generated kernel symbol/ABI variants, changing how hardware launch strategy state is keyed and reused.
